baseline.value: Score 1: No baseline data available on WASH in health care facilities (SDG indicators 6.1 and 6.2)

target.value: 2022:Score 3 (The national protocols for the management of SAM based on WHO standards (2013) have been drafted.)

actual.value: 2022:Score 3: Field work of the WASH assessment in health care facilities was completed by the Environmental and Occupational Health Directorate, Ministry of Health and relevant WASH data is available, representing different levels of health care facilities.
